Ongoing review for the <Language> website translation.

Submit corrections by commenting with:
- Page URL or file path
- Current wording
- Suggested replacement

You may attach corrected files or a ZIP preserving filenames and folder structure. For larger contributions, open a PR targeting `translation/<code>`.

Inline suggestions apply only to lines in this PR's diff. Use comments or attachments for unchanged pages.

Release notes intentionally remain shared in English.

Accepted corrections will be applied and merged in batches.
